title: Cyber Snake
description: High-octane neon cyber snake navigating grid matrices. Eat energy nodes to grow, increase your speed multiplier, and set record high scores.
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to navigate, Space to pause or restart

title: Retro Space Defender
description: Defend the sector from rogue asteroids and hostile space hazards with laser blasters, thrust physics, and deep space combat waves.
controls: Arrow Left/Right to turn, Arrow Up to thrust, Space to fire lasers, P to pause

title: Neon Smash
description: Classic brick demolition redefined with neon particle cascades, multi-tier destructible block walls, and paddle deflection physics.
controls: Mouse or Left/Right Arrow keys to position paddle, Space to launch ball

title: 2048 Master
description: The quintessential mathematical slider puzzle. Combine matching tiles to reach 2048 and conquer the ultimate numerical summit.
controls: Arrow keys or Swipe in any direction to slide and merge tiles

title: Flappy Pixel
description: Test your timing and patience through tricky pipe corridors. Every flap counts in this rhythmic retro flight challenge.
controls: Spacebar, Up Arrow, or Click/Tap anywhere to flap upwards

title: Pong Classic
description: The video game that started it all. Play solo against the predictive CPU paddle or challenge a friend in local 2-Player mode.
controls: P1: W/S or Mouse | P2: Up/Down Arrow keys. First to 7 points wins

title: Minesweeper Retro
description: Logic-driven minefield clearance. Uncover numbers indicating adjacent dangers, flag suspicious zones, and clear the field safely.
controls: Left Click to reveal square, Right Click (or long press) to plant a flag

title: Dino Desert Runner
description: Sprint endlessly through prehistoric desert dunes. Leap over prickly cacti and duck beneath swooping pterodactyls.
controls: Space or Up Arrow to jump, Down Arrow to duck under aerial hazards

title: Connect Four Tactical
description: Drop discs into the 7x6 vertical grid. Create a line of four matching discs horizontally, vertically, or diagonally before your opponent does.
controls: Click any column slot to drop your colored disc into position

title: Cookie Baker Idle
description: Bake delectable cookies with every click. Hire grandmas, construct industrial ovens, and unlock factories to maximize cookies per second.
controls: Click the giant cookie to produce treats and purchase automation upgrades
